title: Kingdom of Bulgaria
capsule: The Kingdom of Bulgaria was proclaimed in 1908 when Prince Ferdinand I declared full independence from the Ottoman Empire, converting the principality established by the Treaty of Berlin (1878) into a sovereign kingdom. Bulgaria fought on the losing side of the Second Balkan War (1913), World War I, and World War II, ceding Southern Dobruja, Western Thrace, and other territories through successive peace settlements; Tsar Boris III died in August 1943 under disputed circumstances after a meeting with Hitler. In September 1946 a communist-controlled plebiscite abolished the monarchy, sending young Tsar Simeon II into exile; opposition leader Nikola Petkov was arrested and executed in 1947 as the People's Republic was formally constituted.
